In this episode I share the best parts from a two day training I taught to over a thousand affiliate marketers. I break down how I turned a Facebook ban into a $120K digital product launch, why short form video is still the biggest free lottery ticket online, and how I use hooks, retention, CTAs, and email capture to build an audience I actually own. Then I walk through the full backend, including Instagram comment automations, lead magnets, landing pages, email workflows, AI voice agents, and even building a simple QuickBooks alternative inside GoHighLevel with one prompt. I also talk about why you do not need a massive audience to make real money, why product audience fit matters, and why the fastest way to learn is to ship, test, and keep going.

Enjoy!
